policy.vocabulary: Keep all original10 Story vocabulary colors. The16 location role accents are a product-layer assignment/extension, not16 simultaneous chart series. Paper is a background, not a quantity.
policy.mapping: Role accent identifies a named subject; a measured numerical ramp encodes values. They are separate contracts.
policy.swot: Four categorical evidence lenses have no generated gradient. A future scored rubric needs an explicit metric contract.
policy.noPurpleBrown: Check every authored role color, anchor and LUT sample against inherited exclusion windows; visual review remains necessary.
policy.chromaHierarchy: Use quiet structural weight, supporting context and focused accents. Urgent red is reserved for a named threat lens; area proportion, text and evidence remain part of hierarchy.
policy.labels: Always label metric, unit, denominator and sign. Pick the declared black/white label color for filled role chips; never reuse a fill color as body text.

steps: Convert exact light role HEX to OKLCH.
Set L=clamp(Llight+0.10,0.48,0.84); retain Hlight. Multiply chroma by role: quiet0.65, supporting0.82, focused0.95, urgent1.00.
Two declared hierarchy slots: urgent threat L≥.63; secondary readiness gold L=.73. They separate important co-displays without changing light colors or hue.
At fixed C/H, raise L in0.001 increments only if rounded contrast<3.05 or banned-hue gate fails.
Map to sRGB using original helper:24-step chroma binary search at fixed L/H, then round to8-bit HEX.
Choose black or white label by maximum contrast.
role-dark-v1.note: Draft rendition heuristic, not an invariant normative formula. Hue is stable within quantization; gamut mapping can reduce chroma.

steps: Keep the semantic end hue for low/high and the distinct semantic midpoint hue.
Low L=.57; if end hue is30–100°, start at.69 to avoid prohibited brown. Low C=min(Cend,.13).
Raise low L in.001 increments only to clear banned hues and3.05contrast.
Mid L=max(.755,lowL+.105), C=min(Cmid,.14), H=Hmid; high L=.93,C=min(Cend,.09),H=Hend.
Construct41 exact OKLab-interpolated samples with anchors at0/20/40; sample3/5/7/9classes.
seq-dark-v1.note: Higher values become lighter on dark canvas; do not reverse the data meaning. Warm gold/orange have shorter usable lightness range.

steps: Both poles target L=.82,C=min(ClightPole,.13), retaining each semantic pole hue.
Zero is exact#3A4145; both arms have monotonic lightness toward/away from zero.
Only when a direct warm arm crosses a forbidden earth region, fade to existing pivot C/H at L=.79,index7 or33 before neutral descent; no authored fourth hue.
div-dark-v1.note: Neutral pivot can be below3contrast; mark zero with text/boundary. Pole meaning is defined by metric, not palette preference.

cvd.method: Machado et al. 2009 full-severity matrices (100), linear sRGB, display-gamut channel clipping, sRGB transfer and 8-bit quantization before OKLab distance
cvd.verified: 2026-10-01 primary Colorspacious cvd.py matrices and conversion.py forward linear-RGB transform read directly
cvd.limits: Screen simulation and pairwise distance screening; no universal accessibility certification or real-user result. Simulated colors can appear brown; the banned-hue rule governs authored normal-view palette values, not the visual effects of a deficiency simulation.
